cards.title: A lighter Riff
cards.body: Crossfade, Smart, lyrics and downloads stay together in the smaller edition.

cards.title: All of Encore
cards.body: Your listening statistics, stories, genres and Encore widget are available in both editions.

cards.title: Your settings travel with you
cards.body: Riff+ adds Automix, the app equalizer and Stats for nerds. About offers the other edition when its release is available. Saved Plus settings return when you move back.
